## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test` passes locally
- [ ] New behavior has tests; a bug fix has a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] No secrets, personal paths, or personal wrapper names in the diff
- [ ] `defaults/catalog.toml` changes are general-purpose (personal setups go in the user config)
- [ ] New TOML examples are in `docs/examples/` with a `tests/unit/docs-examples.test.ts` expectation
- [ ] `README.md`, `README.ru.md`, and `README.zh.md` are updated together and still match
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` is still at most 120 lines and English-only
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated under `[Unreleased]` for user-visible changes
- [ ] Contract, safety, or persistence changes link to the agreed design decision
